title: Exponential separation of self-conformal systems
summary: On the real line, Bárány, Kolossváry, and Troscheit [5] made exponential separation of analytic self-conformal systems checkable through a dual iterated function system on a space of analytic functions. The quantity their condition separates is the pre-Schwarzian derivative, and this observation lets us carry the construction to conformal iterated function systems in every dimension, where the pre-Schwarzian is $T_f=\nabla\log\|Df\|$.
